principle: GitHub Actions is reserved for external evidence acquisition, official settlement and infrequent integrity gates. Deterministic presentation and derived progress belong in the application/browser whenever persistence is not scientifically required.

CAPTURE_REQUIRED.description: Future evidence that would be lost while the app is closed.

POST_DRAW_REQUIRED.description: Low-frequency official result retrieval/settlement with immutable custody.

DERIVED_LOCAL.description: Counters, ETAs, dashboards, ledgers and deterministic summaries.

.github/workflows/loterias-ai-lightning-.reason: Continuity-critical authoritative 30-round source window while local runtime activation is not yet verified.
.github/workflows/loterias-ai-lightning-.removeWhen: A non-Actions runtime reports consecutive successful authoritative-segment-v2 captures with bridgeSafe=true.
